shift_perspective
arguments: {"characters": ["outer character", "inner character"]}

arguments: {}

2. Identify needed perspectives: primarily SEEKER; RECOMMENDER is only context for the latest suggestions. A nested perspective is not needed because the task does not require SEEKER’s model of RECOMMENDER’s beliefs about SEEKER.

Focus on SEEKER’s film preferences, awareness of prior recommendations, and intention to respond to the recommender’s latest suggestions/questions.

6. Call choice_reflection to review the question, earlier tool outputs, and all choices A–D without relying on a gold answer.
7. Call answer to select the best letter for SEEKER’s next strategy.
